description: Checks that fail on the BTPS 1.1 baseline because the defect they prove is not fixed yet. `verify-btps-vectors --known-failing test/vectors/known-failing.json` passes only while the failing set is exactly this list, so each fix ticket must remove its own entries in the same change that makes them pass. Empty since EBA-122 (2026-10-16): every item check passes. Kept, empty, because CI runs the vectors with --known-failing (tests/eba-152); a new check that must fail first is listed here.
